title: 第15章 制卡师
novel_title: 穿越源卡大陆，我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
望着面前的五张一星卡器具卡，还有手中已经变不回去的佣兵佩剑。

    林奇左看看，右看看。

    想着该如何给骷髅士兵配备武器。

    “咦，倘若我这样做呢？”

    他突然灵光一闪，脑子里冒出一个大胆的想法。

    挥手叫过来骷髅士兵，指着地上的佣兵佩剑，对它下令。

    “握住这把剑！”

    骷髅士兵空洞的眼眶里，灵魂之火跳动了一下，伸出粗壮的骨手，稳稳握住了佣兵佩剑的剑柄。

    林奇深吸一口气，集中精神，高声喊道：

    “见证奇迹的时刻，到了！”

    “卡牌召回！”

    随着指令落下，骷髅士兵周身泛起白光，连同手中的佣兵佩剑一起，化作一道流光，飞回林奇手中，重新变成一张卡牌。

    林奇低头一看，满是惊喜。

    卡牌上的图案变了！

    原本只有骷髅士兵的画面，此刻多了一把紧握的佣兵佩剑。

    “好啊，竟然还能这么玩。”

    看到卡牌信息中多出了武器这一栏，林奇激动不已。

    “休息休息，等源力恢复了再给骷髅士兵升阶。”

    揣着五张佣兵佩剑，林奇从前门走出来到店铺。

    林峰正坐在柜台后，将制作好的凝血膏分装进小木盒里。

    感觉到林奇进来，头也没抬的问道：

    “去万卡阁收获如何，买到中意的卡牌了吗？”

    林奇露出一副自信的笑容。

    “当然，不仅买到了我需要的卡牌，以后我们家店铺也可以尝试卖卡牌。”

    “哈哈哈，好小子，有志气。”

    林峰夸赞了两句，也没当回事，继续把制作完成的凝血膏分装进盒子。

    见自己老爹不相信， 他一张一张的把器具卡摆在柜台上。

    作为一名御卡师，林峰很快就感受到了卡牌的特殊波动。

    他看着柜台上的五张器具卡，张了张嘴，把想说的话又咽了回去。

    “爹，想说什么就说，别憋着。”

    见林奇一副鼓励的模样，林峰终于忍不住了，指着柜台上的器具卡，语气带着几分心疼。

    “你个败家孩子！买这么多佣兵佩剑做什么？五张就是一千卡恩啊！这笔钱，你都能买一张绿色品质的器具卡了，不比这五张白色卡实用多了？”

    “卡牌贵不在多，而是在精！毕竟你只是一星卡徒，卡槽空间也只能链接一张卡。”

    说到这，林峰愤愤的神情突然顿了下。

    他突然想起来，以前听佣兵团里的老佣兵说过，有的得天独厚的御卡师，在觉醒卡槽空间时可能会多出几个位置。

    “难道！？”

    林峰凑近林奇，一脸神秘兮兮的说道。

    “儿子，偷偷告诉我，你是不是有好几个卡槽位置？”

    “嗯？”

    林奇一脸疑惑：“我是一星卡徒，只有一个。”

    闻言，林峰一脸懵逼。

    “那你买这五张器具卡是为了什么？不会真打算卖吧？

    咱们石铁城的人买卡牌，都只去万卡阁，那里种类多、信誉好，除非你的价格和黑市一样便宜，不然没人会从我们家买的！”

    “黑市？”

    林奇捕捉到了一个陌生的词。
content_en:
He looked at the five one-star equipment cards in front of him, as well as the mercenary sword in his hand that could not be changed back.

    Lynch looked left and right.

    Thinking about how to equip the skeleton soldiers with weapons.

    "Hey, what if I do this?"

    Suddenly he had a flash of inspiration and a bold idea came into his mind.

    He waved his hand and called the skeleton soldier over, pointed at the mercenary sword on the ground, and gave it an order.

    "Hold this sword!"

    In the empty eye sockets of the skeleton soldier, the soul fire pulsed. He stretched out his thick bone hand and firmly grasped the hilt of the mercenary's sword.

    Lynch took a deep breath, concentrated, and shouted loudly:

    "The time to witness the miracle has arrived!"

    "Card recall!"

    As the command fell, the skeleton soldier's body glowed with white light, and together with the mercenary sword in his hand, it turned into a stream of light, flew back to Lynch's hand, and turned into a card again.

    Lin Qi looked down and was full of surprises.

    The image on the card has changed!

    Originally there were only skeleton soldiers on the screen, but now there is a mercenary sword that is being held tightly.

    "Okay, I can still play like this."

    Lynch was excited to see the weapon column added to the card information.

    "Have a rest and wait until the source of strength is restored before upgrading the skeleton soldiers."

    Carrying five mercenary swords, Lin Qi walked out of the front door and entered the store.

    Lin Feng was sitting behind the counter, packing the prepared coagulation ointment into small wooden boxes.

    Sensing Lin Qi coming in, he asked without raising his head:

    "How was your harvest at Wanka Pavilion? Did you buy the cards you like?"

    Lynch showed a confident smile.

    "Of course, not only did I buy the cards I needed, but our store can also try to sell cards in the future."

    "Hahaha, good boy, ambitious."

    Lin Feng praised a few words, but didn't take it seriously and continued to pack the completed blood coagulation ointment into boxes.

    Seeing that his father didn't believe it, he placed the equipment cards on the counter one by one.

    As a card master, Lin Feng quickly felt the special fluctuations of the cards.

    He looked at the five equipment cards on the counter, opened his mouth, and swallowed back what he wanted to say.

    "Dad, just say what you want to say, don't hold it back."

    Seeing Lin Qi's encouraging look, Lin Feng finally couldn't help it anymore and pointed at the utensil card on the counter with a somewhat distressed tone.

    "You prodigal kid! Why did you buy so many mercenary swords? Five of them are one thousand karn! With this money, you can buy a green-quality equipment card. Isn't it much more practical than these five white cards?"

    "The cards are not more expensive, but more expensive! After all, you are only a one-star card disciple, and the card slot space can only link one card."

    Speaking of this, Lin Feng's angry expression suddenly paused.

    He suddenly remembered that he had heard from the old mercenaries in the mercenary group that some card masters who were blessed with special talents might have a few more positions when they awakened the card slot space.

    "Could it be!?"

    Lin Feng approached Lin Qi and said with a mysterious face.

    "Son, tell me secretly, do you have several card slots?"

    "Huh?"

    Lin Qi looked confused: "I am a one-star card disciple, there is only one."

    Hearing this, Lin Feng was confused.

    "Then why did you buy these five equipment cards? You don't really intend to sell them, do you?

    We people in Shitiecheng only go to Wanka Pavilion to buy cards. There are many types and a good reputation there. Unless your price is as cheap as the black market, no one will buy it from us! "

    "Black market?"

    Lynch captured an unfamiliar word.
